title: Office Party
blurb: Work-safe truths and dares for the Christmas party or Friday drinks.

truth: What's the most creative excuse you've ever given for being late to work?
What's the worst job you've ever had?
What's the longest you've spent pretending to work while doing nothing at all?
Who was your favourite boss ever, and what made them great?
What's the strangest thing you've overheard at work?
What's one meeting you sat through that definitely could have been an email?
If you could ban one office habit forever, what would it be?
What's the weirdest thing you've ever been asked to do at work?
What's the worst Secret Santa gift you've ever received?
What would your job title be if it described what you actually do all day?
What's the most embarrassing thing you've said on a work video call?
What's your go-to snack to survive a long afternoon?
What did you want to be when you grew up, and how close did you get?
What's a work buzzword you secretly love using?
What's the most awkward small talk you've been stuck in at a work event?
What's the first thing you'd change if you were made CEO tomorrow?
Which job would you be hopeless at but love to try for a day?
What's the pettiest thing that has ever annoyed you at work?
What's the best thing a colleague has ever done for you?
What's the most dramatic thing that's happened at a work event you attended?
What's the worst piece of career advice you've ever heard?
What's your worst reply-all regret?
What would your colleagues say is your most annoying work habit?
If you could swap jobs with anyone at the party for a day, who would it be?
dare: Give a 30-second end-of-year motivational speech to the room.
Act out losing a fight with the office photocopier.
Pitch a ridiculous new product to the group in under a minute.
Give a short guided tour of this room like a very serious tour guide.
Present the weather forecast for this room like a TV presenter.
Answer an imaginary phone call as the receptionist of a very fancy company.
Do a dramatic slow-motion high five with the person on your left.
Give everyone in the room a made-up job title based on vibes alone.
Speak like a corporate press release until your next turn.
Sell the person on your right an imaginary stapler with maximum enthusiasm.
Spin around three times and finish in your best power pose.
Act out getting caught online shopping when the boss walks past.
Hum your best phone hold music for 20 seconds.
Write an out-of-office reply for your current mood and read it aloud.
Announce the next player's turn like a game show host.
Perform an interpretive dance called "The Last Day Before Holidays".
Give a heartfelt toast to the most underrated object in this room.
Invent a company slogan for this party and lead the room in chanting it.
Give a mock performance review of the person on your left, kind and ridiculous.
Deliver a 20-second TED talk on how to survive a Monday.
Pretend to be a manager announcing very bad news with a very cheerful face.
Fake a very serious conference call with a mug as your client.
Do your best impression of a person running late to a meeting they are chairing.
Describe the most boring task you do at work as if it were an action movie trailer.
